summary.tpReason: This is a confirmed account compromise, not benign high-volume sign-in behavior: the successful single-factor sessions from 175.45.176.99 immediately performed mailbox manipulation, SharePoint/OneDrive access, created an anonymous edit link, and deleted a OneDrive file. The same AdeleV identity also successfully deleted 12 Azure resources between 20:20 and 20:34 UTC.
summary.fpReason: The Azure resource actions recorded source 37.142.150.162 rather than the alert IP, so telemetry cannot prove that every Azure action used the same client session. However, the identical account and tightly overlapping malicious M365 activity leave very little benign explanation.
summary.whatHappened: adelev@m365x816222.onmicrosoft.com made 53 successful, interactive Browser sign-ins from 175.45.176.99 between 19:57:50 and 21:08:13 UTC on 2021-11-04. All used single-factor authentication, the same Edge/Chrome UA, and no sign-in risk/CA block. From that IP, AdeleV accessed many SharePoint/OneDrive objects, sent mail (20:21:49), created Exchange inbox rule "junk" at 20:22:19 (subject contains "legal", StopProcessingRules=True), created an anonymous EDIT link to OneDrive file Contoso Purchasing Data - Q1.xlsx at 20:33:21, and deleted Timesheet_AdeleV.xlsx at 20:34:31. Separately, AdeleV from 37.142.150.162 successfully deleted 12 Azure resources from six RGs during 20:20:45-20:34:00, including a VM, web site, Key Vaults, workflows/connections, and BTPOC/EY_DEMO resource groups; a Sentinel analytics rule was also written. Same alert-IP activity accessed johns and admin SharePoint content; johns was later seen disabled in the dedicated sign-in table.
keyEvidence: Sign-in telemetry: 56 attempts for AdeleV at 175.45.176.99, 53 successes, 3 failures, 19:57:50-21:08:13 UTC; all interactive Browser, single-factor, and one consistent UA.

OfficeActivity: AdeleV at 175.45.176.99 created an anonymous EDIT link for Contoso Purchasing Data - Q1.xlsx at 20:33:21 UTC, then deleted Timesheet_AdeleV.xlsx at 20:34:31 UTC.
